scope_notes: We check rain, heat, cold, snow, wind and recent rain. We don't yet check thunderstorms, hail, freezing rain or ice, wildfire, air quality, coastal flooding, or geological hazards. For those, follow official warnings.

reply.headline: Typical rain, temperature, snow and wind for Nepal–Tibet border area on 26 Aug 2026.
why: Rain over the last 6 days set the level: Normal rain for the last 6 days (65.6 mm), made up of 59.5 mm in the 5 days before plus the forecast for the day itself.
Totals like this happen about 18 times a year here now, about as common here as in 1951–1980.
Normal wind for here (gusts up to 31 km/h) and normal highs for here (feels like up to 30 °C), though feels-like highs of this level are 3.2 times more common here than in 1951–1980.
reply.what_it_means: The checks do not cover thunderstorms, freezing rain or ice on roads, or geological hazards such as landslides or glacier collapse, which matter in mountain terrain like this. Groundtruth covers weather-driven hazards only, so for landslides, glacier collapse or earthquakes, check local civil protection and geological authorities. Check your official weather warnings before you decide anything.
reply.sms: Groundtruth: Typical rain, heat, cold, snow and wind for Nepal-Tibet border area, 26 Aug 2026. Storms and landslides not checked. See official warnings.
reply.confidence_note: The history is a grid of about 25 km and misses very local storms, and thunderstorms are not checked. The 6-day rain total uses measured rain for the earlier days and the forecast for the day itself; geological hazards need local civil protection and geological authorities.
